footer.tagline: A private messenger for the people who matter.

hero.title: A messenger for the people you actually talk to.
hero.subtitle: DoU gives your circle a cloud of its own: places and chat rooms that only invited people can enter. No feed, no strangers, no noise.

bento.title: Everything has a place.
bento.lead: Your circle gets a cloud. Inside it, a place for each part of life, and chat rooms inside those.

cloud.title: A cloud of your own
cloud.body: Places inside your cloud, chat rooms inside each place. The book club never spills into the family chat again.

invite.title: Invite-only, always
invite.body: No search, no public profile. People come in through an invite link you sent, and nobody else does.

group.title: Up to 100 members
group.body: Big enough for a whole club, small enough that every voice is still heard.

self.title: Self Chat
self.body: A chat room only you can see, for tasks, links and the thought you will want again tomorrow.

manifesto.part1: Not a feed. Not a public square.
manifesto.part2: A quiet place for your people,
manifesto.part3: open only to the ones you invite.

steps.title: From an empty cloud to a room full of your people.
steps.lead: Three moves, and nobody has to learn anything new.

create.title: Create your cloud
create.body: Give it a name and a picture. It is yours, and it starts quiet.

organize.title: Open places and chat rooms
organize.body: A place for the family, another for the team. Each one keeps its own chat rooms.

invite.title: Share one invite link
invite.body: Send it however you like. Whoever opens it lands right inside, in the app or in the browser.

platforms.title: Wherever the conversation is.
platforms.lead: Start on your phone, pick it up at your desk. Same clouds, same chat rooms, same messages.

ios.name: iPhone
ios.body: The native app, on the App Store.

android.name: Android
android.body: The native app, on Google Play.

web.name: Web
web.body: Open DoU in any modern browser. Nothing to install.

desktop.name: Desktop
desktop.body: An app for Mac and Windows that keeps every cloud one click away.

scenes.title: Made for the circles you already have.

family.name: Family
family.body: Dinner plans, photos and a group chat that finally has only family in it.

study.name: Study group
study.body: One place per course, one chat room per problem set. Notes stay where the questions were asked.

team.name: Side project
team.body: Keep the weekend project out of the work messenger, and out of your personal chats too.

club.name: Club
club.body: A hundred members, a handful of chat rooms, and the schedule pinned where everyone can find it.

plans.title: Start free. Go Pro when you want to host.

free.name: Free
free.body: Everything you need to talk in the places you were invited to.
items: Chat in places you were invited to

pro.name: Pro
pro.body: Create your own cloud and bring your people in.
items: Places and chat rooms you create
Group chats with up to 100 members

closing.title: Your people are waiting for an invite.
closing.body: New users get 7 days of Pro free. Download DoU and send the first link today.
